How do I use it properly the very first time?

Perfect! Here's how to use your Oura Ring properly for the very first time:

Before You Start:
Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your Oura charger ready.

Step-by-Step First Use:



Download the Oura App from the iOS or Google Play App Store


Unbox your ring and charger, then plug the charger into a USB power source


Place your ring on the charger - the LED will blink blue when it's ready to pair


Enable Bluetooth on your device


Follow the in-app instructions to create your Oura account and pair your ring 



Proper Wearing:
Wear your ring on your index, middle, or ring finger for best signal quality. It should feel snug but comfortable - not tight or loose. Make sure there's no gap when you make a fist. 

What Happens Next:
You'll get Activity data immediately, but you need one full night of sleep to receive your first Sleep and Readiness scores the next morning.
